{{Top|leg}}
A '''Food Sample Analyzer''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component installed in [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica's]] [[434-FPC Personal Chef Droid]]s. It allowed the droid to sample potential ingredients for edibility, and also allowed the droid to act as a mobile food tester.
